snippet.title: Trailer /// Hello World - a developer story
snippet.description:
🎬 IT'S HERE!

The first official trailer of Hello World just dropped!
Based on the demo that will be playable starting July 18 at BitSummit — and very soon online 👀

💥 What awaits you?
A totally stable, perfectly tuned, almost suspiciously functional experience.
And a dev who clearly knows exactly what he's doing. Probably.
👉 A platformer like no other and built during runtime.

📣 Watch the trailer now, then tell us:
🟢 Are you hyped?
🟢 Will you try the demo on July 18?
🟢 Can you survive what the dev calls "balance"?

‼️WISHLIST NOW ! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834060
✨ It’s not a bug. It’s a feature.™

#HelloWorldGame #IndieDev #GameDev #TrailerDrop #SteamDemo #BitSummit #WishlistIt
